entries.def:
περι-εργάζομαι 
[in LXX: Wis.8.5 א1, Sir.3.23 * ;] 
__1. to waste one's labour about a thing. 
__2. to be a busybody: 2Th.3.11 (cf. Plat., Apol., 19 B).†
(AS)

περίεργος, -ον 
__I. of persons; 
__1. over careful. 
__2. curious, meddling, a busybody: 1Ti.5.13. 
__II. Of things; 
__1. over-wrought. 
__2. super­fluous. 
__3. curious, uncanny; τὰ π., curious arts, magic: Act.19.19 (see Deiss., BS, 3235.).†
(AS)

περι-έρχομαι 
[in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;] 
to go about (as an itinerant): Act.19.13; 28.13 (περιελόντες, WH, R, mg.), Heb.11.37 τ. οἰκίας, from house to house: 1Ti.5.13.†
(AS)

περι-έχω, 
[in LXX for H661, H5362 hi., H6822 pi., etc. ;] 
__1. to surround, encompass: Luk.5.9 (cf. MM, xix). 
__2. to comprehend, include, contain, esp. of books: with accusative, Act.23.25, Rec.; accusative to a late usage, intrans. (BL, § 53, 1.3; MM, xix; Hort, in l), it stands written, 1Pe.2.6.†
(AS)

περι-ζώννυμι and -ύω
(see Veitch, see word), [in LXX chiefly for חָגַר, also for אָזַר, etc. ;] 
to gird (with dupl, accusative, as ὁ περιζωννύων με δύναμιν, Psa.18.32): pass., αἱ ὀσφύες περιεζωσμέναι, Luk.12.35 π. ζώνην χρυσῆν, Rev.1.13; 15.6 (but see infr.). Mid., to gird oneself: Luk.12.37; 17.8 (and so perh. Re, ll. with supr., cf. 1Sa.2.4); with accusative of thing(s) (figuratively), τ. ὀσφύν, Eph.6.14 (before…

περί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(περιτίθημι), [in Sm.: Psa.32.9 * ;] 
a putting around, putting on: 1Pe.3.3.†
(AS)

περι-ίστημι (Rec. ΐστημι) 
[in LXX: Jos.6.3 (סָבַב), 2Sa.13.31 (נָצַב ni.), 1Sa.4.16, Ep. Jer.37.1-21, Jdt.5.22, 2Ma.14.9 * ;] 
__1. to place around. 
__2. to stand around: Jhn.11.42 with accusative of person(s), Act.25.7. Mid. (in late writers), to turn oneself about to avoid, to shun: with accusative of thing(s), 2Ti.2.16, Tit.3.9.†
(AS)

περι-κάθαρμα, -τος, τό
(περικαθαίρω, to purify on all sides or completely, Deu.18.10, Jos.5.4, 4Ma.1.29*), [in LXX: Pro.21.18 (כֹּפֶר)* ;] 
__1. a victim, expiation (Pr, l.with). 
__2. refuse, rubbish: pl., 1Co.4.13 (see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

περι-καλύπτω 
[in LXX for כָּסָה pi., שָׁבַץ pu., etc. ;] 
to cover around, cover up or over. with accusative, Mrk.14.65, Luk.22.64; pass., before χρυσίῳ, Heb.9.4.†
(AS)

περί-κειμαι 
[in LXX: Ep. Je 24, 58, 4Ma.12.3 * ;] 
__1. to lie round about: μύλος, λίθος (RV, were hanged about), Mrk.9.42, Luk.17.2; νεφος μαρτύρων, Heb.12.1. 
__2. to have around one, be clothed with: Act.28.20 figuratively, ἀσθένειαν, Heb.5.2.†
(AS)
